status: frozen exploratory spatial allocation; not accepted historical geography
source_precision: Author's rough computation, not an exact surveyed total or numerical confidence interval
boundary_basis: Nested named-place sensitivity along the Upper Nile valley, including progressively more of the northern transition. Delta Qalyub and Menouf remain excluded. These are inferred game crosswalks, not historical basin polygons.
allocation: Conserve existing fields; distribute additional hectares proportionally to dated cultivated-land evidence, saturating at remaining known conversion land. Zero evidence receives no expansion. Reject an infeasible total. Never use population.
land_bound: Canonical current fields plus exclusive remaining open/forest conversion; agronomic bound only, not proof of historical floodplain access
water_interpretation: Existing hydraulic-system operational coverage range remains 0.8-1.0. Source basin extent and operational water service are separate quantities; no extra annual crop.
expected_effect: Reclassify physically bounded land opportunity as inherited field infrastructure, increasing Nile support without global buffs
validation: Complete Upper Nile provinces plus the existing mandatory central cases at 100/200 years; regional accounting and boundary/weight sensitivity before world comparison
limitations: HYDE and LUH2 are related evidence, not independent holdouts
Allocation weights are uncertain spatial proxies
A feasible land ledger does not validate floodplain or water-volume coverage
Matching the source total by construction is not independent benchmark validation
